entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, you think the Treasure's far?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Didn't we just get in here? Based on[n]how the castle looks, we still have a[n]long way to go.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I still can't believe a phone app took us[n]somewhere like this.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well, not all of us need that app, y'know...[n]The cat can just come in on his own.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I am NOT a cat!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So wait, what's the deal with those[n]soldier things that are serving[n]Kamoshida?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: They transform into weird monsters[n]whenever we fight them...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Huh? Oh, you must be talking about[n]the Shadows.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What are Shadows?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah, I've been wonderin' about those[n]guard dudes too. What's their deal?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I can explain it... but it'll be complicated.[n]Do you want to hear?
It would be good to know.
Not right now.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Deep in the innermost depths of every[n]human's heart lies their true personality—[n]their Shadow.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So it's not that the guards are[n]transforming into those things...[n]Those are their actual forms.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The reason they look like gods and[n]other mythical beings is because they[n]spawn from the human psyche.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wh-Whoa...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But wait, what are they doing in[n]Kamoshida's castle to begin with?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It seems like the distortion of the Palace[n]draws them in.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Once they're here, their forms change[n]and they become underlings for the[n]Palace ruler.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: When you think about it, the Palace[n]ruler is just the Shadow of whoever[n]owns the Palace...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Maybe these places have something[n]to do with the worlds in our minds,[n]or the collective unconscious...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh, okay.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wait, that don't make any sense!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I had a feeling you'd say that...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, you don't need to think too hard[n]about it. They're enemies, so don't let[n]your guard down, okay?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yeah, we don't have the time to be[n]having a long conversation now.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Just know that Shadows are our enemies,[n]okay? Don't let your guard down around[n]them.
